request: Physical TPC/GPC hierarchy and allocation-specific address affinity on exact unchanged fast kernel

micro.timing: source-clock roundtrip, including polling/release/acquire and payload through global mailbox; not one-way inter-SM wire latency
micro.memory: exact same allocation as operator, source-owned base+(page+i)*4096
micro.fit: bottleneck assignment on maximum of 2 training-round cycle matrices; within-GPC and unconstrained; no use of validation/whole-operator times

scheduling: same exact softmax_const.so for every policy, by-value 56-int schedule; no extra kernel, hot fitting, task queue, memory allocation or upload

cadence.io: only between full conditions, not between blocks; fixed GPU prelude after every policy switch

development.selection: fastest of 8 random controls per V/page/scope only; learned algorithm fixed before all GPU observations

statistics: paired within-block medians, equal-process log ratios, 30000 process bootstraps: 95% descriptive and99.84375% Bonferroni32 primary intervals; same-binary ALIAS_IDENTITY checks; all nonprimary cases exploratory
interpretation: require correct numerical outputs, independent process repeatability, advantage over identity and frozen best random and wrong/pooled controls, ready/fresh/batch robustness; disclose setup amortization and observed-run net. Topology classification alone is not physical causality.
stopping: 2 development +6 confirmation then report all; no confirmation-selected policies or repeated search; qualification/sanitizer failures retained.
